addRepo.title: Add a repository
addRepo.body: Paste a repository URL from a host you have registered — DevDigest clones it locally and imports its open change requests. API keys aren’t needed here; set them once in <link>Settings → API Keys</link>.
addRepo.urlHint: The full browser URL of the project, at any namespace depth.

generate.title: Generate onboarding tour
generate.body: DevDigest indexes the repo and specs, then writes a 5-section guided tour: overview, architecture, key modules, getting started, and conventions & gotchas.
